review_method: All four original screenshots were individually opened with view_image and visually inspected; this record summarizes that observed review.
observations: Both complete city, river and foreground compositions are visible, without image cropping.
Desktop comparison places the two images side by side; narrow-screen comparison stacks them with readable titles, controls, evidence cards and downloads.
With JavaScript disabled, both complete artworks, the written evidence and downloads remain available.
V13 is visibly marked as a candidate awaiting review; V12 is identified as the current approved homepage.
The unimplemented three-storey temple south gate is explicitly disclosed in its own early evidence card and again in the remaining limits.
West-wall material evidence, unmeasured palace/storage details, unknown banks, bridgeheads and canal mouths retain readable qualifications.
limitations: This visual review covers actual PR screenshots, not the subsequently deployed production page.
Mobile full-frame images are naturally small; the nine tower storeys were independently assessed in the original full-size image.
Passing the page layout review is not approval to replace the homepage or a claim of complete historical accuracy.
